title: Cost of living protests sweep across Europe
description: Thousands marched across European cities on Friday to protest against the cost of living and other issues.
text: Protests took place across European cities on Friday as marches were held over the cost of living and other issues, including housing shortages and underfunding in education.
Demonstrations took place in Germany, France, Croatia, Italy, the United Kingdom and elsewhere, attracting a lot of young adults.
The BBC's Europe correspondent, Nick Beake, has been reporting from Rome, where thousands of people took part in a march organised by Italy's main trade union.
